notes:
Summary: Mistral CX Navigator provides cloud+on-prem orchestration for mid-to-large contact centers. Evaluating Redwood for a real-time agent-assist POC focused on streaming suggestions and resilient routing under traffic spikes.

What they told us (highlights):
- 'We need token-level suggestions delivered continuously to the agent UI; >95% of user interactions must see a suggestion within 200ms.'
- Pilot target: 50 agents in region us-east, expand to 1,500 agents if successful.
- Primary integration points: Genesys (voice), Salesforce (case/ticket sync), internal tool-calling middleware.

Technical requirements / acceptance criteria:
- Streaming suggestions: incremental token streaming to UI; latency SLO 95th <300ms end-to-end, median ~120-150ms for suggestion start.
- Spike reliability: survive 8-12x traffic spikes during campaign peaks (simulate 10k concurrent sessions).
- Guardrails for tool-calling: explicit human consent flow, sandboxed dry-run, tool-call audit trail and allowlist.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 baseline, KMS/HSM integration, audit logging retained 2 years, PCI scope for payment-related tickets, contractual data residency for EU customers.
- Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdown, per-route dashboards, pull traces for failing flows.
- Cost controls: intelligent caching for common prefixes, quantization/INT8 guidance for dedicated pools.

Current stack & posture:
- Running custom LLMs in-house for non-sensitive tasks; evaluating Redwood to handle production-grade serving, automatic fallback to hosted variants, and Dedicated pools for predictable SLA.
- Very cost-sensitive on per-conversation unit economics; willing to trade model size for throughput if latency maintained.

Sales notes / tone:
- AE: Jordan Kim. SE: Priya Shah. CSM expectation: Liam O'Connor on ramp if POC passes.
- POC ask: 2-week incremental streaming pilot (50 agents) + synthetic spike test, integration runbook for Genesys and SFDC.
- Quote from CTO on call: 'We can't have suggestions that lag — agent trust evaporates after two slow responses.'

Risks / outstanding items:
- Security review with infra team not complete (expected end of Feb).
- Legal wants explicit EU data residency language for EU pilot sites.
- Need Redwood to demonstrate deterministic fallback behavior when primary model overloaded.

Recommended next steps (internal):
- Provide dedicated sizing worksheet and cost estimate for 50->1500 agents.
- Schedule technical deep-dive with Genesys integration engineer.
- Produce runbook for tool-calling guardrails and audit log examples.
